user.title: Connect to Ecotricity
user.description: Use the email address and password of your Ecotricity online account (my.ecotricity.co.uk).

premise.title: Choose a supply address
premise.description: Your account has more than one supply address. Choose the one to add. You can add the others later.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Ecotricity again
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} does not work any more. Enter the new password.

error.invalid_auth: The email address or password is wrong.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Ecotricity portal. Try again later.
error.unknown: The Ecotricity portal sent a response that the integration does not understand. See the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This supply address is already set up.
abort.no_premises: The account has no active supply address.
abort.wrong_account: This password belongs to a different account, or the supply address is not active any more.

auth_failed.message: The Ecotricity portal did not accept the password.

update_failed.message: Could not get data from the Ecotricity portal: {error}
